title: create-objectstack: stamp the blank template's `engines.protocol` from `PROTOCOL_VERSION`, as `os init` does, so template and runtime agree at every commit
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwoXEE1amuRAGHdPBs

③ maintainer-directed task · Source: maintainer — Elon (os-elon-musk), decision card in seat 1's decision thread, 2026-11-26T14:17:40Z, option 1 of 4, label verbatim 「等,并立小卡根治」 (card text: 「19 预发布版本 PR 合并后改造落地;另立小卡让模板版本号跟运行时走,以后升大版本不再卡。容器段临时装刚打的包,不动对外 Docker 文件。」). Decision analysis: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/37441#issuecomment-7194330907 (Q1 option C, "Execution after the ruling" item 2). Ruling record on #37441: see the ruling comment that names this card.

Parent: #37441 (filed under it as a sub-issue) · epic #36941 · Not a governed path ⇒ ordinary landing. Suggested `domain:server` / `area:build` (triage's to confirm); grade p2, the parent's.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么:新项目模板上写的协议版本,改为直接取运行时的协议常量(另一个建项目命令 `os init` 已经这样做),以后升大版本时模板和运行时在主干上始终一致。
- 对外影响:无。发布出去的模板版本号不变,因为发布时包的大版本和协议大版本相同。
- 需要你做的:无。

## Why (business reason)

While the protocol major leads the package major (pre mode), `main`'s blank template stamps the package major (`'^18'`) and the packed runtime implements protocol 19, so a project scaffolded from `main` does not boot (`ProtocolIncompatibleError`). This gap reopens at every major and has now cost three rounds (#22215, PR #37314, #37441). Beneficiaries: every template / Docker PR on a new major line, and the scaffold-e2e tarball job of #37441, which waits on this card or on the version pass, whichever lands first.

## Scope

1. `scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs` stamps the blank template's `engines.protocol` from `PROTOCOL_VERSION`'s major (`packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts`), the same source `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` reads (`PROTOCOL_MAJOR`).
2. `template-consistency.test.ts` compares the template's range against the same constant, not the scaffolder's package major.
3. The blank template (`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts`) moves to the current protocol major (`'^19'` at the time of filing).
4. The docblock sentence in `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts` ("the scaffolder's blank template follows at the version pass") follows the new source.

⛔ No change to `.github/workflows/release.yml` or any other workflow. ⛔ No change to `docker/**`.

## Premise clause

Before editing, the dev runs the version-pass rehearsal PR #37314 used (the post-version validation `release.yml` runs) with the stamp read from the constant. If it reds, the dev reports a fork with the reading; ⛔ no workaround inside `release.yml`, no fallback to stamping the package major.

Re-checks:
- `grep -n "engines:" packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts; grep -n "^export const PROTOCOL_VERSION" packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts` — template `'^18'`, constant `19.0.0` at filing.
- `grep -n "PROTOCOL_MAJOR" packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` — the sibling precedent.

## Acceptance

- On `origin/main` after merge, the range in the blank template equals `^` + `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`.
- `template-consistency.test.ts` reds if the template range and the constant disagree.
- The version-pass rehearsal stays green.
- When this merges, #37441's `Restart-when:` is met (it names this card).

## Reader

Seat repo:objectstack#1, area `o1-A` (epic #36941 follow-ups), after triage's first touch.

Dedupe: `sync-template-versions protocol` (43, none open but #37441), `"engines.protocol" template stamp` (50, none open but #37441); closed neighbours #25510, #9264, #22130 are earlier majors' one-off moves, not this source change.
